title: Exemption to Anguilla Electricity Company Limited (1991) Regulations
text:
R.S.A. c. A55 Exemption for Trading in Securities Regulations R.R.A. A55-14
Revised Regulations of Anguilla: A55-14
ALIENS LAND HOLDING REGULATION ACT (R.S.A. c. A55)
EXEMPTION FOR TRADING IN SECURITIES REGULATIONS
Note: These Regulations are enabled under section 16 of the Aliens Land Holding Regulation Act, R.S.A. c.
A55.
(Am. in L.R. 15/12/2006)
Exemption
1. For the purpose of trading securities under the Securities Act, any alien trading securities on an
exchange licensed by the Eastern Caribbean Securities Regulatory Commission is hereby declared to be exempt
from the provisions of the Act.
Citation
2. These Regulations may be cited as the Exemption for Trading in Securities Regulations, Revised
Regulations of Anguilla A55-14.
